properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Sets the parent asset ID this asset is attached to.

properties.name: Lock movement
properties.description: If enabled the observer does not move anymore.

properties.name: Align with asset tilt
properties.description: Uses the Look at asset, or otherwise the Attach to asset, as the observer’s tilt reference. Disable to keep the observer upright relative to the world.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: World Location of the observer.

properties.name: Relative location
properties.description: Relative location of the observer to the attached asset. Only enabled when attached to an asset.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: World Rotation of the observer. Only enabled when not attached to an asset.

properties.name: Relative rotation
properties.description: Relative rotation of the observer to the attached asset. Only enabled when attached to an asset.

properties.name: Motion Blur
properties.range: Off, High, Mid, Low

properties.description: Name of the asset that the observer shall be following.
